subject: Linear Algebra
title: Vector Spaces — One-Mark MCQ Practice
note: Original ACADRIX practice MCQs aligned to the R-2025 MA25C02 syllabus. These are not official university questions or PYQs.

questions.q: A vector space over a field must be closed under
options: multiplication of any two vectors only
questions.explanation: Closure under addition and scalar multiplication is fundamental to the vector-space axioms.

questions.q: Which of the following is a vector space over R?
options: integers under usual scalar multiplication by R
nonzero real numbers under usual addition
questions.explanation: R² with componentwise addition and real scalar multiplication satisfies the vector-space axioms.

questions.q: The zero vector in R³ is
questions.explanation: The additive identity is the vector whose components are all zero.

questions.q: A subset W of a vector space V is a subspace if it is closed under
questions.explanation: A subspace must itself satisfy the vector-space operations inherited from V; the subspace test includes closure under linear combinations.

questions.q: A subspace must contain the
questions.explanation: Because a subspace is closed under scalar multiplication, multiplying any vector by zero gives the zero vector, which must therefore belong to it.

questions.q: A linear combination of v₁ and v₂ has the form
questions.explanation: A linear combination uses scalar coefficients multiplying the given vectors and then adds the results.

questions.q: The span of a set of vectors consists of
options: all linear combinations of those vectors
questions.answer: all linear combinations of those vectors
questions.explanation: The span is the set of every finite linear combination of the given vectors.

questions.q: A set of vectors generates a vector space when its span is
questions.explanation: A generating set spans every vector in the vector space.

questions.q: A set containing the zero vector is
questions.explanation: The zero vector gives a nontrivial linear combination equal to zero by assigning coefficient 1 to it and 0 to the other vectors.

questions.q: Vectors v₁,…,vₙ are linearly independent if
options: the only solution of c₁v₁+…+cₙvₙ=0 has all cᵢ=0
questions.answer: the only solution of c₁v₁+…+cₙvₙ=0 has all cᵢ=0
questions.explanation: This is the defining condition for linear independence.

questions.q: Two vectors are linearly dependent when
options: one is a scalar multiple of the other
questions.answer: one is a scalar multiple of the other
questions.explanation: For two nonzero vectors, linear dependence occurs exactly when one is a scalar multiple of the other.

questions.q: The rank of a matrix can be used to test linear independence because it gives the
questions.explanation: The rank equals the dimension of the column space and determines the number of linearly independent columns.

questions.q: The columns of a matrix are linearly independent when the column rank equals
questions.explanation: Full column rank means every column contributes an independent direction.

questions.q: A basis of a vector space is a set that is both
questions.explanation: A basis is a minimal generating set: it spans the space and is linearly independent.

questions.q: The standard basis of R² is
questions.explanation: Every vector (x,y) in R² can be uniquely written as x(1,0)+y(0,1).

questions.q: The dimension of R³ is
questions.explanation: The standard basis of R³ contains three linearly independent vectors.

questions.q: Any basis of a finite-dimensional vector space contains
questions.explanation: The number of vectors in any basis equals the dimension of the vector space.

questions.q: If a vector space has dimension n, any set of more than n vectors in it is
questions.explanation: A vector space of dimension n cannot contain more than n linearly independent vectors.

questions.q: If a set of n vectors in an n-dimensional vector space is linearly independent, then it is
questions.explanation: In an n-dimensional space, n linearly independent vectors automatically span the space.

questions.q: If a set of vectors spans V but contains redundant vectors, it is
questions.explanation: A basis must be linearly independent, so redundant vectors prevent the set from being a basis.

questions.q: The set of all solutions of a homogeneous linear system Ax=0 forms a
questions.explanation: The null solution set is closed under addition and scalar multiplication and is therefore a subspace.

questions.q: The column space of a matrix is the span of its
questions.explanation: The column space is precisely the set of all linear combinations of the matrix columns.

questions.q: The dimension of a subspace W is the number of vectors in
questions.explanation: All bases of a finite-dimensional vector space or subspace have the same cardinality, its dimension.

questions.q: The set {(x,y): y=2x} in R² is
options: not a subspace because it is a line
questions.explanation: It contains the origin and is closed under addition and scalar multiplication; it is the span of (1,2).

questions.q: The span of a single nonzero vector in R³ is geometrically a
questions.explanation: All scalar multiples of one nonzero vector form a line passing through the origin.

questions.q: The span of two linearly independent vectors in R³ is a
questions.explanation: All linear combinations of two independent directions form a two-dimensional subspace, a plane through the origin.

questions.q: A generating set can be converted into a basis by removing vectors that are
options: linearly dependent on the remaining vectors
questions.answer: linearly dependent on the remaining vectors
questions.explanation: Removing redundant dependent vectors preserves the span while producing an independent spanning set.

questions.q: If rank(A)=3, the columns of A contain
questions.explanation: Rank is the maximum number of linearly independent columns of a matrix.

questions.q: For vectors in R³, a set of four vectors is necessarily
questions.explanation: The dimension of R³ is 3, so any set containing more than three vectors must be dependent.

questions.q: The main purpose of finding a basis is to obtain
options: a minimal independent set that spans the space
a set containing every vector explicitly
questions.answer: a minimal independent set that spans the space
questions.explanation: A basis provides an efficient coordinate system for representing every vector in the space.
